title: Existence of assembled finite etale local model
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $E$ a sheaf of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets] on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and $\{U_i\to T\}_{i\in I}$ an etale cover, with $I$ in the universe of the schemes. Suppose that for each $i$ the restriction of $E$ transported to the small etale site of $U_i$ is represented by a finite etale $U_i$-scheme [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category]. Put $U=\coprod_iU_i$ with its codiagonal $U\to T$. There is a finite etale $U$-scheme $Q$ and an isomorphism between $E$ restricted to the site localized at $U$ and the lifted Yoneda presheaf of $Q$, precomposed with the equivalence from that localized site to the small etale site of $U$. No descent datum is asserted here.

proof.text: Choose the finite etale representatives Q_i and representation isomorphisms from hrep. Use the localized-site equivalence to regard each isomorphism as a representation of E over U_i.

Form the coproducts U of U_i and V of Q_i, with the morphism V to U induced by the structure maps. The coprojections are disjoint open and closed embeddings. The inverse image of each component U_i is Q_i: the component square is a pullback by disjointness and the coproduct universal property.

On each target component U_i the morphism is finite because its restriction is Q_i to U_i. Target locality makes V to U finite. On each source component Q_i it is the composite of an etale map with an open immersion into U. Source locality makes V to U etale. These properties give a finite etale object Q over U.

For any etale W over U use the disjoint etale covering by W_i=W times_U U_i. The local isomorphisms identify sections of E on W_i with maps W_i to Q_i over U_i. Disjoint-cover sheaf gluing identifies E(W) with the product of those section sets, including the empty index case. The representable presheaf of V has the same gluing property and the same local sections: a map over U lands in the indicated component. Glue the maps and their inverses; uniqueness proves naturality and the inverse equations. Transport through the site equivalence to obtain the stated presheaf isomorphism.

An etale scheme representing restriction of a sheaf on the small etale site carries a descent datum compatible with sections

from.place: Assembly of the local representatives over the coproduct of the cover

lean.statement:
theorem finiteLocalModels_descentDatum_exists
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (E : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (𝒰 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage T)
    (hrep : ∀ i, ∃ Q : (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i).left.FiniteEtale,
      Nonempty (((Etale.overSheafEquiv (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)
        (Type (u + 1))).functor.obj (E.over (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i))).obj ≅
          uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj Q.obj)) :
    let U := 𝒰.sigma.etalePrecoverageToEtale default
    ∃ (Q : U.left.FiniteEtale),
      Nonempty ((E.over U).obj ≅ (Etale.overToEtale U).op ⋙
        uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj Q.obj)
